# The build tools for the sdist and wheel, pinned by version and hash, so a CI
# or release build fetches exactly these files and nothing else. Used by
# .github/workflows/veridor.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml as:
#
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r .github/requirements/build.txt
#   python -m build --no-isolation --outdir dist .
#
# --no-isolation builds with the setuptools pinned here instead of letting the
# build frontend fetch the newest one. Dependabot's pip ecosystem proposes updates.
build==1.6.1 \
    --hash=sha256:ecd351a4be9d35a9eaaba244a7687143c9c7d4aea6ac964e7e7ddab20cbcf4e7
packaging==26.3 \
    --hash=sha256:d7193f7c8e4e93f444fde0262bf90af30e16fa0ad0ad44cb553c87339b23cd1c
pyproject-hooks==1.3.3 \
    --hash=sha256:5fc53fdac9f7bd63fbcdc868fb5f90b4784d78a53a3d3388cd738b807441a20b
setuptools==84.1.0 \
    --hash=sha256:5231689c6ac8156cd155cfb98c3fd6fb252c3e7e9bd3d78b64d3c55f132624c9
